title: Yoisaki Kanade — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Basketball, huh? We didn't do it last time, so it might be nice. I don't have any confidence in my speed, though...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Same here. I've played a little for gym class, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Then, we'll start with dribbling!
Here's a ball!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Give it your best, Ms. Yoisaki!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. Um... I guess I'm only allowed to use one hand for this. There—

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Whoa! I-I only did it lightly and it bounced that much? W-Wait...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huff...I finally made it back.
I can't believe it rolled that far...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Haha. Nice work out there, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well then, let's refocus and have someone give us a demonstration! Hanasato, if you would.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're so good!
Minori, you can play basketball?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. Haruka taught me some techniques once.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I see! Hey, can we see you shoot?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You got it! Here I go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Amazing...
She reached the basket in the blink of an eye.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And she's going straight for a shot...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm sorry!
I forgot how to make a shot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You almost had it, Ichika!
You would've gotten a spare if the ball went just a little further to the right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I really hope I get a strike next time.
Kanade, it's your turn.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It's rolling so slow!
But as long as it doesn't stop...!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
It fell into the gutter right at the end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'll get it next time, that was so close!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Momentum is important too, Kanade!
Give it everything you've got!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! You're okay as long as you don't step on the foul line, so try to throw from as close as possible!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mhm!
Keep it up, keep it up, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone.
Alright, I'll make my second throw.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Momentum...as close to the line as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You did it, Kanade! You knocked down three of the pins!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I was finally able to reach the pins thanks to all of your advice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now if you can just add more momentum, shouldn't you be able to get a strike?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree.
You still have plenty of chances, so do your best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh! Kanade, even your form has gotten much better!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't you think this could be it?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, so close! The four pins on the left are still standing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But now you can aim for a spare!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's a spare, you did it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. She wants to high five, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone.
It took two games, but I finally feel like I'm actually bowling.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Should we go for game three?
You can aim for that strike next!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Honestly, I'm pretty tired, but...
Our scores have been getting better and all, so I'll keep going if you want to.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
In that case, maybe I'll try pushing myself too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Yoisaki.
Hoshino invited me to join you at SpoJoy Park, but I couldn't because of our show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...I'd really like it if we could sit down to talk about music sometime. I want to know how you compose your songs, for one thing... And um, if you like, please do come see another one of our shows.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Kanade!
SpoJoy Park sure was fun. I felt so moved when we high-fived during bowling!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It doesn't have to be for a special occasion like your birthday, but feel free to invite me anytime you want to take a breather! I'll help fill you up with energy, if you don't mind my company!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
Getting songwriting advice, exercising, making scented candles...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's been a lot of fun being able to do all kinds of things with you lately. And...I hope you don't mind me inviting you again when another opportunity comes around!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki. I think basketball and bowling made for a nice workout. I'm sure you're tired, so I'll bring a nutritious meal that'll help you recover.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll keep doing my best to help you in any way I can, so I look forward to spending more time together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I never would've thought I'd end up exercising so much on your birthday, Kanade. My arms and legs are throbbing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Sounds like both of you are sore from your workout, just the way it should be♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean “the way it should be”? I'm in pain over here, I can't even lift my arms.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's because you don't exercise regularly...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Exactly! For your health, we need you to eat well and exercise well! Starting with eating three meals a day, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I do think it would be better to eat properly.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel the same about that. We want you to be able to make lots more songs, Kanade. So take better care of yourself, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I felt the same thing the last time I went to SpoJoy Park, too, but I guess it's possible to have a comfortable sense of exhaustion.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Getting together with everyone to have some fun, and even high fiving each other...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess spending my birthday like this isn't so bad...
